tickets.summary: Customers can check a gift card balance
tickets.description_md:
Customers ask support for their gift card balance about 40 times a week. Add a balance check to the Gift cards page so they can look it up themselves. Balances come from the GiftCo API (GET /v2/cards/{number}).

### Out of scope

- Topping up a card.
- Checking a balance from the checkout page.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a valid 16-digit card number and its 4-digit PIN, when the customer selects Check balance, then the balance is shown in AUD with two decimal places and the card's expiry date.
Given a card number that isn't 16 digits, when the customer selects Check balance, then the message "Enter the 16-digit number on the back of your card" is shown and no request is sent to GiftCo.
Given a valid card number and a wrong PIN, when the customer selects Check balance, then the message "The card number or PIN is wrong" is shown and the balance is not shown.

Given 5 wrong PINs for the same card within 15 minutes, when the customer tries again, then balance checks for that card are refused for 15 minutes with the message "Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes."
Given GiftCo returns an error or takes longer than 3 seconds, when the customer selects Check balance, then the message "We can't check balances right now. Try again later." is shown.
Given a card with a zero balance, when its balance is checked, then $0.00 is shown with the expiry date.
The balance check returns within 500 ms at p95, measured at our API, excluding GiftCo's response time.

tickets.summary: Customers can apply a discount code in the cart
tickets.description_md: Marketing is running a summer campaign and wants codes customers can type in the cart. Codes are created by the promotions team in the admin tool.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a cart with a subtotal of at least $50, when the customer applies the code SUMMER10, then the subtotal is reduced by 10% and the discount is shown as a separate line.
Given an unknown code, when the customer applies it, then the message "That code isn't valid" is shown and the subtotal is unchanged.
The customer can remove the code, and the subtotal goes back to the original amount.

tickets.summary: Checkout crashes when the postcode has a space
tickets.description_md:
### Steps to reproduce

1. Add any item to the cart.
2. Go to checkout.
3. Enter the postcode "20 00" (with a space).
4. Select Continue to payment.

### Expected result

The space is removed, or the message "Enter a 4-digit postcode" is shown.

### Actual result

The page goes blank and the cart is emptied. Happens every time for me on the mobile app.

steps_to_reproduce: Add any item to the cart.
bug.expected: The space is removed, or the message "Enter a 4-digit postcode" is shown.
bug.actual: The page goes blank and the cart is emptied. Happens every time for me on the mobile app.
